<h1>NEWRAD 2026 — Optical Radiometry Conference in Jeju, South Korea</h1>

<p><strong>NEWRAD 2026</strong>, the 16th International Conference on New Developments and Applications in Optical Radiometry, will take place from <strong>September 13 to 17, 2026</strong>, in Jeju Island, South Korea.</p>

<p>NEWRAD is the most directly relevant conference for the emissivity measurement community, covering:</p>

<ul>
<li>Spectral radiance and irradiance measurement</li>
<li>Emissivity and reflectance standards</li>
<li>Blackbody calibration</li>
<li>Detector-based radiometry</li>
<li>Remote sensing applications</li>
</ul>

<p>The conference brings together leading researchers from national metrology institutes worldwide, including NPL, PTB, NIST, NRC, CNAM, and INMETRO.</p>

<p>This is a must-attend event for anyone working in optical radiometry and radiative property measurement.</p>

<p><a href="https://www.newrad2026.org/" class="btn btn-primary">Conference website</a></p>
